captures.stdout:
_mvt_ios_completion() {
    local IFS=$'\n'
    local response

    response=$(env COMP_WORDS="${COMP_WORDS[*]}" COMP_CWORD=$COMP_CWORD _MVT_IOS_COMPLETE=bash_complete $1)

    for completion in $response; do
        IFS=',' read type value <<< "$completion"

        if [[ $type == 'dir' ]]; then
            COMPREPLY=()
            compopt -o dirnames
        elif [[ $type == 'file' ]]; then
            COMPREPLY=()
            compopt -o default
        elif [[ $type == 'plain' ]]; then
            COMPREPLY+=($value)
        fi
    done

    return 0
}

_mvt_ios_completion_setup() {
    complete -o nosort -F _mvt_ios_completion mvt-ios
}

_mvt_ios_completion_setup;

help.text:
Usage: mvt-ios [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

Options:
  --load-command PATH             Load a custom CLI command from a Python file
                                  or folder (can be invoked multiple times)
  --disable-update-check          Disable MVT version update check
  --disable-indicator-update-check
                                  Disable indicators update check
  --help                          Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  check-backup       Extract artifacts from an iTunes backup
  check-fs           Extract artifacts from a full filesystem dump
  check-iocs         Compare stored JSON results to provided indicators
  check-sysdiagnose  Extract artifacts from an iOS sysdiagnose archive
  completion         Generate or install shell completion
  decrypt-backup     Decrypt an encrypted iTunes backup
  download-iocs      Download public STIX2 indicators
  extract-key        Extract decryption key from an iTunes backup
  version            Show the currently installed version of MVT
